Remark
[Wronskian identities for Jacobi fields]

Source: petersen:page-0284 ↗ def:pet-ch6-jacobi-field

1. ch6:6.7.10Let $c$ be a geodesic and $J_1,J_2$ Jacobi fields along $c$. (1) Show $g(\dot J_1,J_2)-g(J_1,\dot J_2)$ is constant. (2) Show $g(J_1(t),\dot c(t))=g(J_1(0),\dot c(0))+g(\dot J_1(0),\dot c(0))t$.
